fields.description:
## Background

Players are Person Accounts (Player record type) created automatically by the SLC intake flows when a link click comes in from the CMS. Each Player accumulates Sign-Up records (Sign_Up\__c, linked via Playerc); a rep works a Sign-Up through Statusc = New → In Progress → Completed. Account.Player_Status_\_c tracks the player lifecycle with four values: **Pending** (default at creation), **Active**, **Inactive**, **Banned**. Today every status change is manual — in practice nothing moves, so all 100 Players in Partial sit at Pending even where sign-ups progressed.

## Outcome

Status maintains itself: first completed Sign-Up activates a Pending Player; 90 days without qualifying activity deactivates an Active one; new activity reactivates an Inactive one; Banned is set and cleared only by authorized humans via a controlled path.

## Guardrail (binds every child)

Automation only ever sets a Player to Active or Inactive, and only Players currently at **Pending, Active, or Inactive** are eligible. Banned is never set, cleared, or overwritten by automation. Audit stamping (Player_Status_Set_Date\__c + Player_Status_Last_Updated_By_\_c) is **centralized in BUILD-251**, which captures every status change regardless of source — UI edits, flows, and data loads. Individual automations do not stamp these fields themselves.

## Children & sequence

BUILD-250 and BUILD-251 are prerequisites; then BUILD-252 → BUILD-253 → BUILD-254; BUILD-255 after BUILD-251.

1. BUILD-250 — Sign-Up: Completion Date stamp (1–2 h)
2. BUILD-251 — Player: centralized status audit stamp (1–2 h)
3. BUILD-252 — Player: Last Activity Date engine, subflow (2–3 h)
4. BUILD-253 — Player: status + sign-up stamps on Completed Sign-Up (3–5 h)
5. BUILD-254 — Player: scheduled Active → Inactive at 90 days (3–4 h)
6. BUILD-255 — Player: Ban button + unban restriction (2–3 h)

Total 12–19 h. All work in **Partial SB**; prod is out of scope.

## Closure rule (every child)

Before closing, add deployed component API names to the ticket and update the requirements doc.

## UAT

Current data in Partial SB supports walking the full Pending → Active → Inactive → reactivation cycle end-to-end.

## Out of scope

* Non-Sign-Up activity sources.
* Historical-data backfill (Partial holds test data only — revisit at data migration; note the BUILD-253 flow fires on data loads that set Status = Completed, so the migration runbook must deactivate it or plan for mass activation).
* BA/Primary/Secondary Referrer defaulting on first completed Sign-Up (proposed to client, unconfirmed — separate ticket if approved).
* Notifications on deactivation.
* Prod deployment.
* Reason-based reactivation gating — today Inactive only ever means inactivity, so any Inactive Player is eligible for reactivation; revisit gating by Player_Status_Reason__c if other Inactive reasons come into use.

## Open questions

1. Qualifying activity = Completed Sign-Up only for v1 — communicated in the client Q&A doc without objection; chase explicit OK from Emily/Lina or treat the doc as sign-off.
2. BA/Referrer defaulting — awaiting client confirmation; new ticket if yes.
